{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.shape)
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check unique values in key columns
print(f"Unique arms: {df['arm'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique severities: {df['severity'].unique()}")
print(f"Unique assay_batches: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check if there are any control-arm patients with moderate severity
control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]
print(f"Control-arm, moderate-severity patients before deduplication: {len(control_moderate)}")

# Check response rate among them
print(f"Responded count in control-moderate: {control_moderate['responded'].sum()} out of {len(control_moderate)}")"}
